summary: Frontend testing completed. React hydration issue from iteration_1 is FIXED. All authentication flows (register/login) work correctly for all 3 roles (Client, Walker, Admin). All dashboard pages load and navigation works. CRITICAL ISSUE: Supabase RLS (Row Level Security) policies are not configured, causing 403 errors when clients try to add dogs, and preventing admin from viewing walkers/clients data.

critical.issue: 403 Forbidden - RLS policy missing for clients to insert their own dogs
Admin cannot read profiles - shows 0 walkers/clients even though they exist. RLS policy missing for admin role
Clients cannot view available walkers - 'No walkers available' even though walker registered. RLS policy missing

integration_issues.issue: Supabase insert fails with 403 - RLS policy not configured for dogs table
Cannot book walk because no dogs can be added (blocked by RLS)
Shows 0 walkers and 0 clients even though accounts exist - RLS policy blocking read

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies are not configured for the database tables (dogs, profiles, walker_profiles, bookings, walk_logs)
reproduction_steps: 4. Fill in dog details and click Save
5. Observe: Toast shows 'Failed to add dog', console shows 403 Forbidden
evidence: Console error: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 ()'
Admin dashboard shows 0 walkers/clients despite accounts existing
Find Walkers page shows 'No walkers available' despite walker account existing
potential_causes: RLS is enabled on Supabase tables but no policies are defined
Policies may exist but don't match the user roles/conditions correctly
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Main agent needs to add RLS policies to Supabase. Example for dogs table: CREATE POLICY 'Users can manage their own dogs' ON dogs FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = owner_id) WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = owner_id);
